author: Inside Edition
description: Chocolate magnate Milton Hershey will have his portrait painted on the big screen this year, in the new biopic "Hershey." But what's the real story behind America's most famous chocolatier? Biographer Michael D'Antonio told Inside Edition Digital that the candyman did indeed bring chocolate to the masses, and founded the town and the school that bear his name. But when it came to labor disputes, "he could be an autocrat."
title: What's The Real Story Behind 'Hershey?'
